name: Lentil, Tomato & Mixed Greens Salad with Avocado & Garlic Bread

instructions.primary_message: Rinse lentils under cold water and transfer to a small saucepan. Add water and salt; bring to a boil. Reduce heat to a simmer and cook until tender 15-20 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ cups brown lentils
3 cups water
⅜ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Peel and mince garlic. In a small bowl, mix together ¾ of the garlic (save the rest for the salad), oil, and Italian seasoning.
instructions.secondary_message:
12 cloves garlic
6 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
3 tsp Italian seasoning

instructions.primary_message: Place buns or rolls cut side up in a small baking dish. Spoon olive oil and garlic mixture on the bread.
Place in the oven and bake until bread is crusty, 10-12 minutes.
In a small bowl, prepare dressing by whisking together remaining garlic, oil, vinegar, Dijon, salt, and pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
9 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
3 tbsp balsamic vinegar
¾ tsp Dijon mustard
⅜ tsp salt
⅜ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry greens. Wash, dry, and cut tomatoes into wedges. Halve and pit avocados; scoop out and medium dice. Wash, trim root ends, and chop green onions. Transfer everything to a large bowl.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ (142 g) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)
3 tomatoes
3 avocados
1 ½ small bunches green onions

instructions.primary_message: Drain lentils and add to bowl. Toss salad.
To serve, place salad on a plate, drizzle with dressing, and have with garlic bread on the side. Enjoy!
